title: The Long Echo
author: Quentin Reyes
blurb: Rosalind Brightwater, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
